0.0: You defeated #rTreglow#k... or at least part of him. His real body may be elsewhere. \r\n#L0##bI found something weird.#l\n#k
0.1: That looks like one of the fragments each guardian held before Heliseum was taken from us. It appears to be a dragon's leg... Maybe the other guardians have the rest.\r\n#L0##bThe other guardians? You mean Victor and...#l\n#k
0.2: Yes. Your next target is #rVictor#k. We will concern ourselves with #rVelderoth#k when we reach that juncture. \r\n#L0##b(...)#l\n#k
0.3: #rVictor#k's room will be just as difficult to access as Treglow's.\r\n#L0##bI can handle any challenge.#l\n#k
0.4: Good, because #rVictor#k has created a host of creatures to protect himself. #b#p3001007##k tells me there is a force of high-ranking Specters blocking the area, along with some strange flag-looking beasts. Make sure to bring back samples...\r\n#L0##bSamples?#l\n#k
0.5: Anything will do. Just eliminate #r100 of Victor#k's creations and bring me #b40#k of whatever you find.\r\n#r#e(You will move to the quest map automatically upon accepting.)

yes.0: Get yourself ready combat-ready and head to the castle. Look for a spire with lots of artwork. That will be #rVictor#k's calling card.

no.0: Please talk to me again once you are fully prepared.

0.msg: I don't think I have enough of anything to examine.
I can tell you haven't defeated enough monsters yet. Don't ask me how, I just know these things.
Victor's ability to materialize objects is astounding. It's also all based on a magical relic, so this should take me very little time to unravel.

1.msg: There is a physical basis to these forms. It appears they are made of... junk, rubbish. There's a very complex enchantment that weaves it into a living thing.

2.msg: I'll pull these apart and see what I can find. You rest your head for now. I know this was a lot of knowledge to take in...
